findings.problem: REQ-CAT-102, REQ-CAT-101, QR-CAT-047 and QR-CAT-016 take a Variant's earliest-created active barcode whatever its type or unit, and RULE-CAT-037 counts any active barcode. Two counter-cases have no statement and no test. (1) If the only active barcode is a SCALE code of 4 to 6 digits, the label is printed with a code that is unreadable on its own. (2) If the earliest barcode is bound to CARTON, a piece label scans as a carton.
findings.fix: Use only active GTIN or INTERNAL barcodes whose uomCode equals the Item's baseUomCode, earliest-created first. Change REQ-CAT-101, REQ-CAT-102 and the specs of QR-CAT-016 and QR-CAT-047 accordingly. RULE-CAT-037 then counts only such barcodes, and a Variant with none is flagged and gets the existing API-CAT-056 next action. Add one AC and one TC for each of the two counter-cases.

findings.problem: The unit of the Bundle component quantity (ENT-CAT-007.quantity) is never stated, yet INV and SLS split a Bundle into component movements. Units with a conversion factor make this ambiguous: two implementers can read the same quantity differently.
findings.fix: State that the quantity is always in the base unit of the component Variant's Item. Change ENT-CAT-007, REQ-CAT-056, REQ-CAT-058 and CON-CAT-006 to say so. Return the unit as a derived property componentBaseUomCode in BundleComponentView, the DTO, the api-spec and the manifest, and show it in the Bundle components pane. Add one AC and one TC.

findings.problem: The frontend plan's header and its ALIGN-FE heading say 55 operations, and the amended note of ADR-CAT-051 says 55 operations with 53 used. The API document holds 56 operations and the totals say 54 of 56. This is the same stale-count defect that platform finding 8 records.
findings.fix: Re-stamp the counts to 56 operations and 54 used in the frontend plan's header, its ALIGN-FE heading and the amended note of ADR-CAT-051. The rule-level fix stays with the factory under platform finding 8.
